title: Symmetrized polynomials in a problem of estimating of the irrationality measure of number ln 3
relevant_concepts: linear independence measure of 1, log 2, log 3
notes: Chebyshevskii Sbornik 19 (2018) 15-25. ν(1, ln 2, ln 3) ≤ 4.116201, hence μ(log 3) ≤ 5.116201, a 10^{-4} improvement of Wu–Wang 2014. Cited by the Juggler fan-growth branch only to record that later polynomial-shape sharpenings do not change the conclusion; not imported as a new attack.
